Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> It is a foil printing of the [[Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]] card.<ref name="foil-face">[[:File:Reflections-III-Foil-D-Power-Of-The-Hutt-PSA-photo-141992718-original.jpg|Original printed Reflections III foil face]], PSA Set Registry source collection.</ref>
|lore=Jabba runs his organization out of a palace built around a B’omarr monastery. His fortress near the border of the western Dune Sea is safe from enemies in Mos Eisley.<ref name="foil-face" />
|game_text=Deploy on table. Once during each of your turns, may deploy one Boelo, Bib, Ephant Mon, Jabba’s Sail Barge, Jabba’s Space Cruiser, or Hutt Influence from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Also, your aliens aboard Jabba’s Sail Barge are immune to attrition &lt; 6. (Immune to Alter.)<ref name="foil-face" />
